label: GO step late in the episode (trials 90-99) when the agent strongly picks a2
explanation: Fires only at GO, only when the agent picks a2 (model_act == 2 covers 100% of mass; choice logit strongly favors a2), and almost only in the last 10 trials of an episode (96% of mass at ep_trial 90-99, none before trial 80). Equivalently, it fires when the value-head output is low (value < 5.22 holds 99.8% of mass), and late-episode value drops. Predicate uses only observed or self-computed quantities: the GO policy logit and episode position. It never fires at D1/D2, early in the episode, or on a1 choices. Precision is about 0.6: many late-episode a2 GO steps stay silent, mostly after rewarded trials. Magnitude is modulated by the previous reward: activations after an unrewarded trial are about 0.8-1.0 of max, versus about 0.1-0.3 after a rewarded one (prev_reward == 0 holds 78% of mass on about half the active steps). The more frequent firing when S1 started as good (start_high) / S2 is now good follows from a2 being chosen then. Alternative value < 4.5 & choice < -4.44 scored dev F1 0.76 vs 0.73. I recorded the episode-position version because it is easier to interpret.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
